# Lab 2.9: Storage Billing: Logical vs Physical

## What We Are Going to Do
Compare logical and physical bytes for your tables and switch a dataset to the physical (compressed) storage billing model.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Compare the two models.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  table_name,
  ROUND(active_logical_bytes / POW(1024, 3), 3) AS logical_gib,
  ROUND(active_physical_bytes / POW(1024, 3), 3) AS physical_gib,
  ROUND(time_travel_physical_bytes / POW(1024, 3), 3) AS time_travel_gib,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(active_logical_bytes, active_physical_bytes), 1) AS compression_ratio
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE
WHERE table_schema = 'lab02'
ORDER BY logical_gib DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] See the model.** Open `lab02 → Details`. **Storage billing model** shows **Logical** (the default).

3. **[CLI] Switch to physical billing.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq update -d --storage_billing_model=PHYSICAL lab02
bq show --format=prettyjson lab02 | grep storageBillingModel</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Same change with SQL, on another dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">ALTER SCHEMA lab02_scratch SET OPTIONS (storage_billing_model = 'PHYSICAL');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   After a change, you must wait **14 days** before you can switch back.

5. **Decide.** Physical billing usually wins when the compression ratio is above about **2x** and the time travel window is short.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Logical bytes | Uncompressed size |
| Physical bytes | Compressed size, plus time travel and fail-safe bytes |
| Switch | Dataset-level setting |
| Switch back | Only after 14 days |
